author: Ubisoft
description:
🏆 Award-winning. Expanded. Complete.
On December 3, Apple Arcade players can experience Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown+ with all major post-launch content included:
⚔️ Warrior's Path Update
👑 Boss Attack Update
✨ Divine Trials Update
🌑 Mask of Darkness Story DLC
New modes. New challenges. New bosses. New story content.
Available December 3 on Apple Arcade for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

#PrinceOfPersia #AppleArcade #ubisoft #Gaming #metroidvania
title: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown is coming to Apple Arcade!

Luxury sedan, unapologetic muscle car spirit. Meet the Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing.

Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing, available on Nov. 11th in #TheCrewMotorfest and included in the Year 4 Pass

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!
